findings.passage: Last week, the Michigan Legislature rushed through a few bills that, if enacted, would disenfranchise vulnerable voters here in Michigan. I voted no on all of the bills.
findings.note: E-newsletter section headed Voter ID Bills, written in the first person by the Livonia representative, on Senate Bills 303 and 304 passed that month.

findings.passage: We already have a voter ID law here in Michigan that works.
findings.note: Same newsletter. She says current law, in which voters without ID sign an affidavit, already works, and that more than 10,000 people used it in the 2020 election.
subjects: sworn statement for voters without ID

findings.passage: SB 303 also requires anyone applying for an absent voter ballot to take additional steps to prove their identity, such as mailing copies of their licenses or portions of their Social Security number.
findings.note: Same newsletter. She describes the absentee-ballot ID step in SB 303 and adds that it puts people at risk of identity theft.
